PROP-6a4369e9-inv-047.text: Peer-reported custody_group_count must be validated against NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS upper bound before use in any loop or data structure sizing. handle_custody_groups must terminate in O(NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS) iterations regardless of the peer-advertised value.
PROP-6a4369e9-inv-047.assertion: forall peer_cgc: handle_custody_groups(peer_cgc, ...) terminates AND iterations <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS, even when peer_cgc > NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS

locations.note: calculates sampling size from custody_group_count parameter
